products.name: change_impact
products.description: This association product represents the impact relationship between an engineering change order and the specific parts it affects. It captures the detailed scope, timing, and analysis of how each change affects each individual part. Each record links one change to one affected part with attributes that describe the nature and implementation details of that specific impact.. Existence Justification: In automotive PLM, engineering changes routinely affect multiple parts (a single ECO may update dozens of parts in an assembly), and parts are subject to multiple changes over their lifecycle (design improvements, cost reductions, regulatory updates). The business actively manages the 'change impact' or 'affected part list' as a core PLM workflow, tracking which parts are affected by each change with part-specific implementation dates, impact analysis, and scope. This is a recognized operational entity in Teamcenter Change Management.

It represents the many-to-many relationship that should be properly modeled in the change_impact association table. Each part reference should be a separate change_impact record with its own impact_analysis, effective_date, scope, and implementation_date.]

products.name: compliance_evidence
products.description: This association product represents the compliance evidence linking validation tests to homologation requirements in the type-approval process. Each record captures the formal mapping between a specific validation test execution and a regulatory requirement it satisfies, including compliance status, test result applicability, and approval tracking. This is a core operational entity in homologation engineering, actively managed by regulatory compliance engineers to demonstrate type-approval readiness.. Existence Justification: In automotive homologation and type-approval processes, validation tests and regulatory requirements have a genuine many-to-many operational relationship. A single validation test (e.g., WLTP emissions test) satisfies multiple regulatory requirements across different markets (EPA, CARB, Euro 6d), and a single requirement (e.g., FMVSS 208 frontal impact) is proven by multiple tests (crash test, sled test, simulation validation). Homologation engineers actively manage compliance evidence mappings as a core business process, tracking which tests satisfy which requirements with approval status, submission dates, and reviewer sign-offs.

attributes.description: The total actual machine/equipment hours consumed during execution of this production order, as recorded by SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems or MES. Used for OEE analysis, machine utilization reporting, and cost variance calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; SCADA; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when production activities for this order actually commenced on the shop floor, as recorded by the MES or confirmed by the first operation confirmation in SAP PP. Used for cycle time analysis and schedule adherence measurement.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: assembly_sequence_number
attributes.description: The Just-in-Sequence (JIS) sequence number assigned to this production order, defining its position in the assembly line build sequence. Critical for JIS supply chain synchronization — ensures parts arrive at the line in the exact order vehicles are built. Managed by MES and communicated to tier-1 suppliers.

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of vehicles or sub-assemblies that have been confirmed as successfully produced and goods-receipted against this order. Maps to SAP PP confirmed yield quantity (WEMNG). Used for production performance and yield tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production order record was first created in the source system (SAP PP). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management. Maps to SAP order creation timestamp (ERDAT + ERZET).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard_cost and actual_cost amounts on this production order (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, MXN). Determined by the plant's controlling area currency in SAP CO.

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production order involves the use or production of hazardous materials (e.g., battery electrolytes for EV/HEV powertrains, paint solvents, chemical treatments). True = hazardous materials involved, requiring compliance with EPA, CARB, and ISO 14001 environmental management protocols.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production order record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for change tracking, delta load processing in the lakehouse pipeline, and audit compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: mes_order_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system for this production order. Used to correlate SAP PP orders with shop floor execution records in the MES for traceability and real-time production control.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the units being produced under this order. Critical for regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA, NCAP), warranty tracking, and production program management. Typically a 4-digit year (e.g., 2025).
attributes.references: NHTSA; EPA; CAFE Standards; SAE International

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the production order was created and issued in SAP PP. This is the principal business event date representing when the manufacturing work order was formally raised. Maps to SAP order creation date (ERDAT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the production order providing additional context about the manufacturing scope, special instructions, or engineering change notes. Used by shop floor supervisors and production planners for operational clarity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the production order as assigned by SAP PP (Production Planning) or Apriso MES. This is the business-facing reference used on the shop floor, in MES screens, and in cross-system communication. Maps to SAP PP order number (AUFNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production order within the SAP PP and MES workflow. 'created' = order created but not yet released to shop floor; 'released' = released for execution; 'in_progress' = active manufacturing underway; 'partially_confirmed' = some operations confirmed; 'confirmed' = all operations confirmed; 'technically_completed' = TECO status in SAP — production complete, pending settlement; 'closed' = fully settled and archived; 'cancelled' = order voided. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|released|in_progress|partially_confirmed|confirmed|technically_completed|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production order indicating its manufacturing purpose. 'vehicle_build' represents a full vehicle assembly order; 'sub_assembly' covers component or module builds (e.g., powertrain, axle); 'rework' covers defect correction orders; 'repair' covers warranty or field return repairs; 'prototype' covers R&D and pre-SOP (Start of Production) builds. Maps to SAP PP order type (AUART).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which all production activities for this order are planned to be completed. Used for delivery commitment, JIT (Just-in-Time) scheduling, and OTD (On-Time Delivery) performance tracking. Maps to SAP PP planned finish date (GLTRS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: planned_labor_hours
attributes.description: The total planned direct labor hours required to execute this production order, derived from the routing standard times and target quantity. Used for capacity planning, workforce scheduling via SuccessFactors, and standard cost calculation in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; SuccessFactors; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: planned_machine_hours
attributes.description: The total planned machine/equipment hours required to execute this production order, derived from routing standard machine times. Used for equipment capacity planning, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) baseline, and standard cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which production activities for this order are planned to begin, as determined by MRP (Material Requirements Planning) or production scheduling. Maps to SAP PP planned start date (GSTRS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MRP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: ppap_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) approval is required before this production order can be released for full-volume production. Typically True for new part introductions, engineering changes, or supplier changes. Governed by IATF 16949 and AIAG PPAP standards.

tag_set.value: Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) Required Flag

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority level assigned to this production order for shop floor scheduling and sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by MES and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) systems to determine execution order when multiple orders compete for the same resources.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS

attributes.name: production_stage
attributes.description: The manufacturing stage or shop area where this production order is executed. Reflects the physical production process: 'stamping' = metal forming; 'body_shop' = body-in-white welding; 'paint' = surface coating; 'final_assembly' = vehicle assembly; 'powertrain' = engine/transmission build; 'trim_chassis' = trim, chassis, and final fit.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5; SAE International

attributes.name: quality_inspection_lot
attributes.description: The SAP QM (Quality Management) inspection lot number created for quality inspection activities associated with this production order. Links production execution to quality results, usage decisions, and non-conformance records. Maps to SAP QM inspection lot (QMNUM).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: release_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production order was formally released to the shop floor for execution. Release triggers material staging, capacity reservation, and MES order activation. Maps to SAP PP order release date/time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units that required rework (non-conforming units corrected and returned to production flow) during execution of this order. Distinct from scrap — reworked units are salvaged. Used for quality cost analysis and APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; APQP

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units scrapped or rejected during production of this order due to quality defects or process failures. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation, scrap cost analysis, and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/QM Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC

attributes.name: sop_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production order is part of the SOP (Start of Production) launch phase for a new vehicle program. True = SOP launch order subject to enhanced quality monitoring and APQP controls; False = regular series production order.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: The planned standard cost to produce the target quantity under this order, calculated from the BOM (Bill of Materials) component costs and routing activity rates in SAP CO (Controlling). Expressed in the plant's local currency. Used for cost variance analysis and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of vehicles or sub-assemblies to be produced under this order, expressed in the base unit of measure (typically 'EA' for each). Maps to SAP PP planned order quantity (GAMNG). Used for capacity planning and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: technical_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the production order was set to Technically Completed (TECO) status in SAP PP, indicating all manufacturing operations are finished and the order is pending cost settlement. Distinct from actual_finish_timestamp which records the last physical operation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure for the target and confirmed quantities on this production order (e.g., EA = Each for vehicles, PC = Piece for components, SET for kits, KG for bulk materials). Maps to SAP base unit of measure (MEINS).

attributes.name: vin_range_end
attributes.description: The last VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) in the sequential range assigned to units produced under this order. Together with vin_range_start, defines the complete set of vehicles traceable to this production order for recall, warranty, and homologation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J272

attributes.name: vin_range_start
attributes.description: The first VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) in the sequential range assigned to units produced under this order. VINs are 17-character alphanumeric identifiers conforming to ISO 3779. Used for build traceability, recall management, and regulatory reporting to NHTSA.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J272

attributes.name: wip_posting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether WIP (Work in Progress) costs have been calculated and posted to the financial ledger for this production order in the current period. True = WIP posted; False = WIP not yet posted. Used for period-end financial closing in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP/IFRS IAS 2

products.name: vehicle_build
products.description: Transactional record capturing the actual build event for a single vehicle unit on the shop floor, from body-in-white through final assembly. Tracks VIN assignment, production order reference, actual start and completion timestamps per build stage (stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final), build status, shift, operator team, and any hold or rework flags. SSOT for vehicle-level build traceability and genealogy in the manufacturing domain. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: Apriso MES Vehicle Traceability / VIN Build Record

attributes.description: Primary key for vehicle_build

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Required for OTA update management: associate each built vehicle with its connected vehicle record for remote diagnostics, firmware deployment, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: ecu_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecu_specification. Business justification: Each vehicle build has a specific ECU software/hardware version flashed at end-of-line. This FK is essential for OTA update eligibility, recall campaigns by ECU software version, and regulatory softwa

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Vehicle build completion triggers finished-goods inventory journal entries (WIP-to-finished-goods transfer posting). Direct FK enables auditors and cost accountants to trace each completed vehicle bui

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Each built vehicle must be tied to its Homologation_Record for VIN‑level compliance verification and reporting.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this vehicle was assembled. Enables plant-level production reporting and capacity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Plant / Work Center

attributes.name: powertrain_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.powertrain_spec. Business justification: Each vehicle build is produced to a specific engineering powertrain specification. This FK enables warranty traceability, recall campaigns, and homologation audits linking the physical build to the ap

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.build_stage. Business justification: Vehicle build references its current build stage; replace string column with FK to build_stage for normalization.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PP production order that authorized and scheduled this vehicle build. Links the build event to the manufacturing planning hierarchy.

attributes.name: assembly_line_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific production/assembly line within the plant on which this vehicle was built (e.g., LINE-A1, TRIM-LINE-3). Used for line-level throughput analysis, bottleneck identification, and SCADA/PLC integration.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Center / Line Assignment; SAP PP – Work Center

attributes.name: battery_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the high-voltage traction battery pack installed in this vehicle (applicable to HEV, PHEV, BEV). Null for ICE vehicles. Critical for EV battery genealogy, warranty, and end-of-life regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2; EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542; CARB ZEV Regulations

attributes.name: body_shop_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the body shop stage was completed and the body-in-white was released to the paint shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: body_shop_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body-in-white (BIW) entered the body shop for welding and assembly. Key milestone for build genealogy and stage cycle time tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The body style classification of the vehicle being built. Used for production line routing, tooling selection, and regulatory homologation grouping.
attributes.references: SAE J1100 – Vehicle Body Style Classification; UNECE Regulation No. 55

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: The specific BOM (Bill of Materials) version or engineering change level used to build this vehicle. Captured at build time for genealogy and recall traceability. Links to Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability

attributes.name: build_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle build was completed at the final assembly stage and signed off for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if the build is still in progress. Used for cycle time, throughput, and SOP/EOP milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Actual Finish; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: build_sequence_number
attributes.description: The Just-in-Sequence (JIS) production sequence number assigned to this vehicle on the assembly line. Determines the order in which vehicles are built and parts are delivered to the line. Critical for JIS/JIT supply chain synchronization.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Sequence Number; SAP PP – JIS Sequencing

attributes.name: build_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the vehicle build process commenced at the first production stage (typically body-in-white or stamping entry). Principal business event timestamp for the build lifecycle. Used for cycle time calculation and OTD (On-Time Delivery) analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Actual Start; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: build_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vehicle build record. Drives shop floor workflow, MES gating, and production reporting. 'on_hold' indicates a quality or material hold; 'rework' indicates a defect requiring corrective action before completion.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Work Order Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle build type: standard (full local assembly), CKD (Completely Knocked Down – assembled from imported kits), SKD (Semi Knocked Down), pilot (pre-SOP trial build), or prototype (engineering validation). Affects BOM, duty classification, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PP – Order Type; WTO Customs Valuation; IATF 16949 APQP

attributes.name: chassis_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the chassis assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: chassis_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the chassis assembly stage for powertrain marriage, suspension, and drivetrain installation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vehicle build record was first created in the MES/data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event, distinct from the build_start_timestamp which is the actual shop floor event time.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: end_of_line_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the automated end-of-line (EOL) functional test performed on the completed vehicle, covering powertrain, brakes, ADAS, and electrical systems. Distinct from quality_gate_status which covers visual/dimensional inspection.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; DOT FMVSS – Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; SAE J1739 FMEA

attributes.name: engine_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the engine unit installed in this vehicle during chassis assembly. Critical for powertrain genealogy, warranty traceability, and recall management.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

attributes.name: final_assembly_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the final assembly stage was completed and the vehicle was released for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: final_assembly_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the final assembly stage for fluids, wheels, glass, and end-of-line checks.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is currently under a production hold (True = on hold). A hold may be triggered by a quality non-conformance, missing parts, engineering change, or safety concern. Drives MES gating to prevent further assembly until resolved.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Management

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the production hold applied to this vehicle build (e.g., QUALITY_DEFECT, MISSING_PART, ECN_CHANGE, SAFETY_CONCERN). Null if hold_flag is False. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QUALITY_DEFECT|MISSING_PART|ECN_CHANGE|SAFETY_CONCERN|SUPPLIER_DEVIATION|TOOLING_FAILURE|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Reason Codes

attributes.name: homologation_market
attributes.description: The target regulatory market for which this vehicle is homologated and built (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR, CHN, AUS). Determines applicable safety, emissions, and labeling standards. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.
attributes.references: UNECE Vehicle Regulations; NHTSA 49 CFR; Euro NCAP; CARB; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicle being built (e.g., 2025). Determines applicable regulatory standards, BOM revision, and homologation requirements. Distinct from the calendar year of production.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J1297 – Model Year Definition

attributes.name: paint_color_code
attributes.description: The manufacturer's paint color code applied to this vehicle during the paint stage (e.g., G1W – Super White, 040 – Classic White). Used for paint shop scheduling, color sequencing optimization, and customer order matching.
attributes.references: SAP PP – Configuration / Variant; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Configuration

attributes.name: paint_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the paint stage was completed and the vehicle body was released to the trim/general assembly line. Null if stage not yet completed.

attributes.name: paint_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body entered the paint shop for priming, painting, and clear-coat application.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; ISO 14001 – Environmental Management (paint VOC emissions)

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly line routing, tooling, and EPA/CARB emissions compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; SAE J1715

attributes.name: quality_gate_status
attributes.description: Result of the end-of-line quality gate inspection for this vehicle build. 'conditional_pass' indicates the vehicle passed with minor deviations requiring dealer rectification. Drives release-to-shipping authorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6 – Release of Products; APQP; Euro NCAP; NHTSA FMVSS

attributes.name: rework_count
attributes.description: Number of rework operations performed on this vehicle build. A count greater than zero indicates quality issues encountered during assembly. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation and FMEA analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC – Statistical Process Control; APQP

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build has been flagged for rework due to a detected defect or non-conformance (True = rework required). Distinct from hold_flag; a vehicle can be in rework while not on hold.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; FMEA Process

attributes.name: scheduled_build_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which this vehicle was scheduled to be built per the production plan (MRP/MES schedule). Used to measure schedule adherence and production plan vs. actual variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scheduled Finish Date; MRP Planning

attributes.name: sop_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is part of the official Start of Production (SOP) launch batch (True = SOP vehicle). SOP vehicles are subject to enhanced quality scrutiny and PPAP sign-off requirements.
attributes.references: APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning; PPAP – Production Part Approval Process; IATF 16949

attributes.name: stamping_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the stamping stage was completed and the body panels were released to the body shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: stamping_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body panels entered the stamping stage. Used for stage-level cycle time analysis and production flow monitoring.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: transmission_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the transmission unit installed in this vehicle. Used for drivetrain genealogy, warranty claims, and component-level recall traceability.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

attributes.name: trim_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the trim assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: trim_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the trim assembly stage for interior fitting, electrical harness installation, and dashboard assembly.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this vehicle build record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trails, and detecting stale records in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: The globally unique 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to this vehicle unit at body-in-white or VIN stamping stage. Conforms to ISO 3779 / NHTSA VIN standard. SSOT for vehicle-level traceability across manufacturing, sales, and after-sales domains.

attributes.description: Manufacturing process stage covered by this schedule record. Reflects the major shop areas in automotive assembly: stamping (metal forming), body shop (welding/joining), paint (surface treatment), final assembly (powertrain/trim installation), or trim-chassis-final (TCF integrated line).
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Routing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Total available production capacity in hours for this schedule period on the assigned production line, accounting for planned downtime, maintenance windows, and shift patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: Body style classification of the vehicles scheduled for production. Used for production line configuration, tooling setup, and capacity planning by body type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Classification; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: build_sequence_end
attributes.description: Ending sequence number for the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build order within this schedule period. Together with build_sequence_start defines the range of vehicle sequence numbers assigned to this schedule.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Sequencing

attributes.name: build_sequence_start
attributes.description: Starting sequence number for the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build order within this schedule period. Used by MES and AGV systems to sequence vehicle bodies through the production line in the correct order.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Sequencing

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production build type. 'standard' = full series production; 'ckd' = Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit assembly; 'skd' = Semi Knocked Down (SKD) assembly; 'pilot' = pre-production pilot build; 'pre_series' = pre-series validation build.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; APQP Phase 4-5; IATF 16949

attributes.name: calloff_transmission_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when supplier delivery call-offs were transmitted to the supply base for this production schedule. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking and supplier performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4; JIT Standard

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Planned capacity utilization percentage for this schedule period, calculated as (confirmed_quantity × takt_time) / available_capacity_hours × 100. Stored as a planning input from SAP PP capacity leveling, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Leveling; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Number of vehicles confirmed for production after capacity leveling, constraint resolution, and production planning approval. May differ from planned_quantity due to capacity constraints or material availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production schedule record was first created in the system, either by an MRP run or manual entry. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Official End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model/model year. Schedules beyond this date are invalid. Used for phase-out planning, last-time-buy procurement, and regulatory deregistration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; NHTSA Homologation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month number 1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year. Enables alignment of production volumes with financial reporting periods for management accounting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Fiscal Period; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this production schedule belongs. Used for financial planning, CapEx allocation, and EBITDA reporting alignment between production volumes and financial periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Fiscal Year; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: freeze_horizon_date
attributes.description: Date up to which the production schedule is frozen and cannot be changed without formal change control. Protects supplier call-offs and JIT/JIS delivery commitments within the frozen window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planning Time Fence; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4; JIT/JIS Standard

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this schedule record is currently within the freeze horizon and locked against changes. True = frozen (no modifications allowed without change control); False = open for revision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planning Time Fence; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this production schedule record. Updated on every revision, status change, or quantity adjustment. Essential for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicles being scheduled. Used for regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA), BOM versioning, and sales planning. Typically one year ahead of the calendar year for SOP planning.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; EPA CAFE Standards; SAE International MY Definition

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles planned for production in this schedule period as determined by the MRP run. Represents the gross requirement before capacity and constraint adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP Planned Order Quantity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology classification for the vehicles in this schedule. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; EV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Drives regulatory reporting (CAFE, EPA, CARB) and BOM variant selection.
attributes.references: EPA CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; NHTSA FMVSS; SAE J1711

attributes.name: regulatory_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary regulatory market for which these vehicles are being produced. Determines applicable homologation standards (NHTSA/FMVSS for USA, UNECE for Europe, etc.), emissions certification (EPA, CARB, Euro 6), and CAFE compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|DEU|GBR|CHN|JPN|KOR|AUS|BRA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; EPA Emissions Standards; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; CARB; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: schedule_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description for the most recent schedule revision. Examples: material shortage, capacity constraint, demand change, quality hold, tooling failure, model mix adjustment. Required for change control audit trail per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 (Document Control); SAP S/4HANA PP Change Management

attributes.name: schedule_date
attributes.description: The principal planned production date (or start date of the weekly/monthly bucket) for this schedule record. Represents the real-world business event date when production is planned to occur.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planned Order; IATF 16949

attributes.name: schedule_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the production schedule period. For daily schedules this equals schedule_date; for weekly/monthly buckets this marks the last day of the planning period.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for production planners to record contextual notes, exceptions, or special instructions associated with this schedule record. Examples: tooling changeover notes, quality hold references, special customer order constraints.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the production schedule record, sourced from SAP PP (Production Planning). Used for cross-system reference and communication with supply chain and manufacturing teams.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production schedule record. 'draft' = initial planning; 'released' = approved for execution; 'frozen' = within freeze horizon, no changes allowed; 'in_execution' = active shop floor production; 'completed' = all planned units built; 'cancelled' = schedule voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Time granularity of the production schedule record. 'daily' = day-level MPS; 'weekly' = weekly bucket plan; 'monthly' = monthly capacity plan. Determines the planning horizon and supplier call-off frequency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the production schedule. Each MRP (Material Requirements Planning) run or manual revision increments this counter, enabling version comparison and rollback analysis.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production is scheduled to complete for this schedule record. Used for shift planning, takt time validation, and downstream logistics coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Order Scheduling; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production is scheduled to begin on the line for this schedule record. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing, AGV routing, and supplier call-off timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Order Scheduling; Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Shift configuration planned for this production schedule period. Determines available production hours and workforce requirements. Single = 1 shift/day; Double = 2 shifts/day; Triple = 3 shifts/day; Weekend = weekend-only production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Official Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model/model year being scheduled. Marks the formal launch of series production. Used to validate that schedule dates fall within the active production window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Program Management; APQP Phase 5

attributes.name: supplier_calloff_generated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether supplier delivery call-offs (JIT/JIS delivery schedules) have been generated and transmitted to suppliers based on this production schedule. True = call-offs sent; False = pending call-off generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; JIT/JIS Standard; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds per vehicle unit for this production schedule. Takt time = available production time divided by customer demand rate. Drives line balancing, AGV pacing, and JIS sequencing intervals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Rate Routing; Apriso/Dassault MES; SAE Manufacturing Standards

products.name: production_bom
products.description: Manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM) record representing the production-level BOM used on the shop floor for a specific vehicle configuration and model year. Distinct from the engineering BOM (eBOM) in the engineering domain — this is the manufacturing BOM (mBOM) as released to production. Captures BOM header (vehicle model, MY, plant, effectivity dates), BOM status, and reference to the engineering change order that authorized it. Managed via SAP PP and Teamcenter PLM BOM transfer. [preservation_guardrail: verified]
products.reference: SAP PP Manufacturing BOM (mBOM) / Teamcenter BOM Transfer

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the manufacturing Bill of Materials (mBOM) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP PP BOM Header (CS01/CS02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: BOM Management Report requires each BOM to be tied to a vehicle model to ensure correct component list per model.

attributes.name: plant_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.powertrain_spec. Business justification: The production BOM is variant-specific to a powertrain configuration. Linking to powertrain_spec enables APQP/PPAP traceability from manufacturing BOM to the approved engineering powertrain specificat

attributes.name: primary_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_supplier. The denormalized supplier_number column confirms this relationship exists. Replacing

attributes.name: production_ebom_reference_bom_id

attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this manufacturing BOM (mBOM) to the originating engineering BOM (eBOM) in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from shop floor execution back to the engineering design intent. The eBOM-to-mBOM transformation is managed via the PLM-SAP integration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; PTC Windchill EDM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

tag_set.value: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: production_bom has a denormalized production_line_code STRING attribute. attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_contract. attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM received formal approval from the designated authority. Precedes the release_date in the BOM lifecycle workflow. Required for IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the approving authority (e.g., Chief Engineer, Manufacturing Manager) who approved this BOM for production release. Distinct from released_by — approval may be a separate workflow step in Teamcenter PLM or SAP workflow.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.3 – Design and Development Outputs; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: Current APQP phase associated with this BOM's program lifecycle. Phase 1=Plan and Define, Phase 2=Product Design and Development, Phase 3=Process Design and Development, Phase 4=Product and Process Validation, Phase 5=Launch/Feedback. Tracks BOM maturity relative to the program development gate.
attributes.references: AIAG APQP 2nd Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Program Management

attributes.name: assembly_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is assembled as a Completely Built Unit (CBU), Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit for overseas assembly, or Semi Knocked Down (SKD) kit. Determines the BOM structure, component packaging, and applicable customs/import regulations for the target market.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Type; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; Customs Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The base quantity of the header material for which the BOM component quantities are defined (e.g., 1 vehicle). All component quantities in the BOM are expressed relative to this base quantity. Corresponds to the SAP BOM header base quantity field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Base Quantity; ISO 9001 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the BOM base quantity (e.g., 'EA' for each/vehicle, 'PC' for piece, 'SET' for set). Corresponds to the SAP material master base unit of measure. Ensures consistent quantity calculations during MRP explosion and production order processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|L|M|M2|M3|SET — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: bom_alternative
attributes.description: SAP BOM alternative identifier (e.g., '01', '02') distinguishing multiple valid BOM configurations for the same material and plant. Supports variant BOMs for different production lines or regional configurations (e.g., LHD vs RHD, CKD vs SKD).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Alternative; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the manufacturing BOM, typically including the vehicle model, model year, plant, and key configuration attributes (e.g., '2025 F-150 XLT 3.5L EcoBoost AWD – Detroit Assembly Plant – MY2025 Production BOM'). Used for display in SAP, Teamcenter PLM, and reporting tools.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Description; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: The maximum depth/level of the BOM hierarchy for this manufacturing BOM (e.g., 1 = single-level, 5 = five levels deep). Used to understand BOM complexity and to control multi-level BOM explosion in MRP and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Multi-Level BOM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the manufacturing BOM. 'draft' indicates the BOM is under engineering review. 'released' means it has been authorized for production use. 'frozen' indicates no further changes are permitted (e.g., during active production run). 'superseded' means a newer BOM version has replaced it. 'obsolete' means the BOM is no longer valid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use in the manufacturing process. 'production' is the standard mBOM used on the shop floor. 'phantom' represents sub-assemblies that are not stocked. 'sales' is used for variant configuration. 'spare_parts' is for after-sales service. 'co_product' is for by-products in manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Category; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_usage
attributes.description: SAP BOM usage indicator defining the organizational context in which the BOM is applied. 'production' (SAP usage 1) is the standard for shop floor manufacturing. 'engineering' (SAP usage 2) is for design/development. 'universal' (SAP usage 3) applies across all usages. Determines which BOM is selected during MRP and production order processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Usage (T415); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the manufacturing BOM (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Incremented each time the BOM is revised through an approved Engineering Change Order. Enables version history tracking and rollback capability for quality investigations.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Versioning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Change History

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for creating or modifying this BOM version (e.g., 'Cost reduction – substitute supplier for part X', 'Regulatory compliance – CARB Tier 3 emission update', 'Quality improvement – NVH fix per TSB-2024-001'). Required for IATF 16949 change control documentation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6 – Control of Changes; SAP PP Change Master; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.6

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct component line items (BOM positions) in this manufacturing BOM. Provides a quick indicator of BOM complexity and is used for completeness validation during BOM release. Does not include phantom sub-assembly components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Item Count; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturing BOM record was first created in the source system (SAP PP or Teamcenter PLM). Represents the business event of BOM creation, not the ETL load time. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this manufacturing BOM version is no longer valid for production use. Corresponds to the SAP BOM 'Valid To' date. Null indicates the BOM is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used to manage BOM transitions during model year changeovers and End of Production (EOP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this manufacturing BOM version becomes effective and valid for production use. Corresponds to the SAP BOM 'Valid From' date. Used for date-effective BOM explosion in MRP and production order creation. Aligns with Start of Production (SOP) planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAE J1739

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production of this vehicle configuration ceases. Used for last-time-buy planning, spare parts provisioning, and regulatory compliance archiving.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAP PP Production Planning; APQP

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory homologation (type approval) for the vehicle configuration defined by this BOM in the target regulatory market. 'approved' is required before vehicles built to this BOM can be legally sold in the target market. Managed through the Regulatory Compliance and Homologation process.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 567 – Certification; UNECE WP.29 Type Approval; Euro NCAP; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM uses SAP Variant Configuration (VC) to support multiple vehicle variants from a single configurable BOM structure. True = configurable BOM with characteristic-based component selection. False = fixed BOM for a single specific vehicle configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration (LO-VC); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: is_phantom_assembly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the header material of this BOM is a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that is not physically stocked or produced as a discrete unit. Phantom assemblies are 'exploded through' during MRP and production order processing. Common for sub-assemblies in JIS manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Phantom Assembly (Special Procurement Key 50); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this manufacturing BOM record in the source system. Used to detect changes during incremental data loads into the Databricks Silver Layer and to support BOM change history auditing required by IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP BOM Change History; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number of the header material (finished vehicle or major assembly) for which this BOM is defined. This is the top-level material in the BOM hierarchy, corresponding to the vehicle configuration or assembly unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master (MM60); SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The four-digit automotive Model Year (MY) for which this manufacturing BOM is valid (e.g., 2025). Determines the applicable regulatory standards, feature content, and homologation requirements. Aligns with NHTSA and EPA model year definitions.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN; SAP PP Material Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Status of the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) for the components in this BOM. PPAP is the AIAG/IATF 16949 process that verifies supplier components meet design and specification requirements before production launch. 'approved' is required before the BOM can be released to production.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1; SAP QM – Quality Notifications

attributes.name: predecessor_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the previous manufacturing BOM version that this BOM supersedes. Enables backward navigation in the BOM version chain for change impact analysis and quality investigations. Null for the initial BOM version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the target regulatory market for which this BOM is homologated (e.g., 'US-FEDERAL', 'US-CARB', 'EU-EURO6', 'JP-JC08', 'CN-CHINA6'). Determines applicable emissions standards (EPA, CARB, Euro 6, WLTP), safety regulations (NHTSA FMVSS, UNECE), and CAFE compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR – FMVSS; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13; Euro NCAP; UNECE WP.29; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM was formally released to production (status changed to 'released'). Marks the point at which the BOM is authorized for use in production orders and MRP planning. Corresponds to the SAP BOM release date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Release; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; APQP Phase 4

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the manufacturing engineer or release authority who formally released this BOM to production in SAP PP or Teamcenter PLM. Required for audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP Authorization; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision level of the BOM (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' or '01', '02'). Used in conjunction with bom_version to track incremental changes within a version. Aligns with SAP BOM revision level and Teamcenter PLM revision management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Revision; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production begins using this BOM configuration. Critical for program management, supplier readiness, and PPAP completion tracking.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: superseded_by_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the newer manufacturing BOM that has replaced this one (populated when bom_status = 'superseded'). Enables forward navigation in the BOM version chain for traceability and historical analysis. Null when this is the current active BOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model (nameplate) for which this mBOM is defined (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Used to associate the BOM with the correct vehicle program in PLM and SAP.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP Material Master

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: defect_code

attributes.name: defect_description

attributes.name: defect_location_code

attributes.name: detection_method_code

attributes.name: detection_timestamp

attributes.name: disposition_code

attributes.name: inspection_point_code

attributes.name: is_safety_related

attributes.name: line_stoppage_flag

attributes.name: planned_rework_hours

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp

attributes.name: re_inspection_result

attributes.name: rework_attempt_count

attributes.name: rework_instruction_reference

attributes.name: rework_material_cost

products.name: routing_operation
products.description: This association product represents the operational step between a routing and a work center. It captures the specific manufacturing operation performed at a work center as part of a routing sequence. Each record links one routing to one work center with attributes that define the operation parameters, sequencing, timing, and execution details. This is the foundational entity in SAP PP and MES systems for shop floor execution and production scheduling.. Existence Justification: In automotive manufacturing, a routing defines a multi-step production process, and each step (operation) is performed at a specific work center. One routing contains many operations at different work centers (e.g., stamping → welding → painting → assembly), and one work center participates in many different routings (e.g., the welding station is used in SUV routing, truck routing, sedan routing). The routing operation is the fundamental unit of shop floor execution in SAP PP and MES systems.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Inventory management for raw materials, components, WIP (Work in Progress), finished goods, and service parts across plants, warehouses, and dealer networks. Manages stock levels, inventory movements, cycle counting, MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution, and SKU master data. Tracks inventory accuracy, turnover rates, obsolescence, and safety stock levels. Includes warehouse management (SAP WM), lot traceability, and serialized inventory for high-value components (ECU, batteries).
