attributes.description: Dealer priority tier assigned for this allocation cycle, determining precedence when vehicle supply is constrained. Tier 1 dealers receive first allocation rights based on performance metrics, sales volume, or strategic importance.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Network Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: production_plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility where the allocated vehicle(s) were or will be produced. Used for logistics routing, transport cost calculation, and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM regional zone code (e.g., NORTHEAST, SOUTHEAST, CENTRAL, WEST) grouping territories for macro-level allocation planning, regional incentive programs, and zone manager oversight.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; OEM Regional Distribution Policy

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the dealer's reason for rejecting this allocation (e.g., excess inventory, wrong specification, cash flow constraints, market demand mismatch). Null when allocation is accepted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excess_inventory|wrong_spec|cash_flow|demand_mismatch|facility_capacity|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; OEM Dealer Agreement Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_production_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the allocated vehicle unit(s) are scheduled to enter the production line. Derived from the Start of Production (SOP) schedule and used for delivery window planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Apriso/Dassault MES; APQP Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this allocation record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing across SAP S/4HANA SD, CDK Global DMS, and Salesforce Automotive Cloud.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales territory code within which the dealer operates. Used for regional allocation quota management, zone-level supply balancing, and territory performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Automotive Cloud Territory Management

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used to deliver the allocated vehicle(s) from the production plant or port of entry to the dealership. Drives logistics cost allocation and delivery lead time estimation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation Management; DOT Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

products.name: dealer_inventory
products.description: Real-time inventory of vehicles physically on-hand or in-transit at a dealership. Tracks VIN, nameplate, model year, trim, exterior/interior color, powertrain, days-on-lot, acquisition cost, current asking price, inventory status (available, sold, demo, loaner, in-transit), and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) completion flag. Sourced from CDK Global DMS inventory module.

attributes.name: dealer_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dealer inventory record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Inventory Turnover Optimization monitors connectivity status of inventory vehicles to prioritize sales of connected models.

attributes.name: finished_vehicle_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.finished_vehicle_stock. Business justification: REQUIRED: Allocation traceability report needs to map each dealer inventory record to the originating finished‑vehicle stock for compliance and recall tracking.

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Inventory management must ensure each stocked vehicle model is homologated for the market; linking inventory to homologation records supports compliance checks.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Inventory manager ownership is tracked for inventory reconciliation and loss prevention reporting.

attributes.name: powertrain_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.powertrain_spec. Business justification: Window sticker generation, inventory search/filter by powertrain, and EPA/WLTP range display all require linking dealer inventory to the authoritative powertrain spec. Replaces denormalized engine_des

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that physically holds or is allocated this inventory unit. Sourced from CDK Global DMS dealer master.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku. Business justification: Inventory management report requires linking each dealer inventory record to the SKU definition for pricing, specs, warranty and compliance.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Dealer lot management and PDI bay assignment require knowing which physical storage_location a dealer_inventory unit occupies. location_code is a denormalized representation of storage_location. Domai

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.vehicle_allocation. Business justification: Dealer inventory is created as a result of a vehicle allocation — the OEM allocates a specific vehicle unit to a dealership, and that unit then appears in dealer inventory. dealer_inventory.allocation

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.vehicle_build. Business justification: Needed for Vehicle Traceability report, connecting each inventory record to its exact build record for warranty and recall actions.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Inventory allocation report needs to know which OEM vehicle order supplied each stocked vehicle.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The dealer's total landed cost for this vehicle unit, including invoice price, transportation/destination charges, PDI costs, and any dealer-installed accessories. Used for gross profit calculation and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; GAAP ASC 330 – Inventory

attributes.name: asking_price
attributes.description: The dealer's current advertised or asking retail price for this vehicle unit. May differ from MSRP due to market adjustments, dealer markups, or promotional discounts. Updated dynamically based on market conditions and days-on-lot.
attributes.references: FTC Used Car Rule; CDK Global DMS – Pricing Module

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The vehicle body style classification (e.g., sedan, SUV, pickup truck, van). Used for inventory segmentation, lot management, and sales reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sedan|coupe|SUV|crossover|pickup_truck|van|minivan|wagon|convertible|hatchback — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAE J1100 – Vehicle Body Style Classification

attributes.name: certified_pre_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this used vehicle unit has been certified under the OEM's Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) program, meeting specific age, mileage, inspection, and reconditioning standards. True = CPO certified; False = not CPO certified. CPO vehicles carry extended warranty coverage and premium pricing.
attributes.references: OEM CPO Program Standards; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: days_on_lot
attributes.description: The number of calendar days this vehicle unit has been physically present on the dealer's lot since the received date. A key inventory aging metric used to trigger price adjustments, incentive programs, and wholesale decisions. Aged inventory (typically >60 days) incurs floor plan interest costs.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; CDK Global DMS – Inventory Aging

attributes.name: dms_record_reference
attributes.description: The source system record identifier from CDK Global DMS for this inventory unit. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load processing between the DMS source and the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: drivetrain
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration of the vehicle: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Key inventory search and customer preference attribute.
attributes.references: SAE J1297; CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Specifications

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: The estimated date the vehicle unit is expected to arrive at the dealership from the OEM or transport carrier. Relevant for in-transit inventory. Used for customer pre-order management and lot planning.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Tracking; OEM Logistics

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned paint/exterior color code for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'NH-883P' for Sonic Gray Pearl). Used for inventory search, customer matching, and lot locator functions within CDK Global DMS.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Color Codes

attributes.name: exterior_color_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the exterior paint color (e.g., 'Sonic Gray Pearl', 'Midnight Black Metallic'). Used for customer-facing display and sales consultation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Marketing Materials

attributes.name: floor_plan_date
attributes.description: The date on which floor plan financing commenced for this vehicle unit. Used to calculate accrued floor plan interest costs and curtailment schedules. Null for vehicles not financed via floor plan.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; CDK Global DMS – F&I Module

attributes.name: floor_plan_lender
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution providing floor plan (wholesale) financing for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'Ford Motor Credit', 'Ally Financial', 'Chase Auto Finance'). Floor plan financing is the short-term credit line dealers use to fund vehicle inventory.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; Dodd-Frank Act

attributes.name: fuel_economy_city_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-rated city fuel economy for this vehicle configuration in miles per gallon (MPG), or MPGe for electric/hybrid vehicles. Required disclosure on the Monroney label and used for CAFE compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 – Fuel Economy; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: fuel_economy_highway_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-rated highway fuel economy for this vehicle configuration in miles per gallon (MPG), or MPGe for electric/hybrid vehicles. Required disclosure on the Monroney label and used for CAFE compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 – Fuel Economy; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was placed into service (sold and delivered to a retail customer, or placed into demo/loaner service). Marks the start of the OEM warranty period. Null if the vehicle has not yet been placed in service.
attributes.references: OEM Warranty Policy; NHTSA Recall Tracking

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned interior color/trim code for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'BK' for Black). Used for inventory matching and customer preference alignment.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Interior Codes

attributes.name: interior_color_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the interior color and material (e.g., 'Black Leather', 'Sandstone Cloth'). Used for customer-facing display and sales consultation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Marketing Materials

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the vehicle unit within the dealer inventory lifecycle. 'available' = on-lot and saleable; 'sold' = retail sale completed; 'demo' = dealer demonstration unit; 'loaner' = service loaner vehicle; 'in_transit' = allocated but not yet physically received; 'reserved' = held for a specific customer; 'wholesale' = designated for wholesale/auction disposal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|sold|demo|loaner|in_transit|reserved|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Status Codes; NADA Guidelines

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle unit by its condition and ownership history: 'new' = new vehicle never titled; 'used' = previously owned/titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' = OEM-certified used vehicle meeting specific age/mileage criteria; 'demo' = dealer demonstration vehicle; 'loaner' = service loaner vehicle. Governs applicable pricing, warranty, and financing programs.
attributes.references: FTC Used Car Rule; OEM CPO Program Standards; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: invoice_price
attributes.description: The OEM invoice price charged to the dealer for this vehicle unit, representing the dealer's acquisition cost from the manufacturer before holdback, dealer cash, or other incentives. Confidential commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement; NADA Dealer Financial Standards

attributes.name: last_price_update_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asking price for this vehicle unit was most recently updated in the CDK Global DMS. Used to track pricing strategy cadence and ensure market-aligned pricing for aged inventory.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Pricing Module; NADA Market Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for this specific vehicle unit including all factory-installed options and packages, expressed in the local currency (USD). Established by the OEM and used as the baseline for dealer pricing and incentive calculations.
attributes.references: Monroney Sticker Price Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); FTC Regulations

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Current odometer reading of the vehicle in miles at the time of inventory check-in or last update. Critical for used, demo, and loaner vehicles to determine CPO eligibility, warranty coverage, and pricing. For new vehicles, reflects delivery mileage.
attributes.references: Federal Odometer Act (49 U.S.C. § 32701); CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) has been completed for this vehicle unit. PDI is a mandatory dealer quality check performed before vehicle delivery to a customer, verifying all systems, fluids, and accessories meet OEM standards. True = PDI completed; False = PDI pending.
attributes.references: OEM PDI Standards; IATF 16949 – Dealer Quality Requirements

attributes.name: pdi_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer's service technician. Null if PDI has not yet been performed.

attributes.name: recall_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle unit is subject to an active NHTSA safety recall that prevents retail sale or delivery until the recall remedy has been performed. True = vehicle is on recall hold and cannot be sold; False = no active recall hold. Critical for regulatory compliance and consumer safety.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573 – Safety Recall Reporting; FAST Act Section 24109

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle unit was physically received and checked into the dealer's inventory from the OEM transport carrier or trade-in. Marks the start of the days-on-lot aging clock and floor plan financing period.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Check-In; NADA Floor Plan Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dealer inventory record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dealer inventory record was most recently updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the dealer acquired this vehicle unit: 'factory_order' = ordered directly from OEM; 'dealer_trade' = acquired via dealer-to-dealer trade; 'auction' = purchased at wholesale auction; 'trade_in' = accepted as customer trade-in; 'fleet_return' = returned from fleet/rental program; 'lease_return' = returned at end of lease term.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Acquisition; NADA Guidelines

attributes.name: stock_number
attributes.description: Dealer-assigned internal stock number used within the CDK Global DMS to identify and locate this vehicle on the lot. Unique within a dealership but not globally unique.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission fitted to the vehicle: automatic, manual, CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission), DCT (Dual-Clutch Transmission), or single_speed (for BEV). Used for inventory filtering and customer preference matching.
attributes.references: SAE J1297; CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Specifications

attributes.name: transport_status
attributes.description: Current transportation status for vehicles in the delivery pipeline from OEM plant to dealership: 'not_shipped' = awaiting dispatch from plant; 'in_transit' = en route via carrier; 'delivered' = arrived at dealer; 'rail' = currently on rail transport; 'truck' = currently on truck transport.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Tracking; OEM Logistics System

attributes.name: window_sticker_url
attributes.description: URL link to the digital Monroney window sticker (required by the Automobile Information Disclosure Act) for this vehicle unit, hosted by the OEM or a third-party service. Contains MSRP, standard equipment, options, fuel economy ratings, and safety information.
attributes.references: Automobile Information Disclosure Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); EPA Fuel Economy Label

products.name: retail_sale
products.description: Records the retail sale of a new or used vehicle by a dealership to an end customer. Captures VIN, sale date, sale price, MSRP, discount amount, trade-in details, financing type (cash, retail finance, lease), F&I products sold, salesperson, and deal status. Sourced from CDK Global DMS F&I module. SSOT for dealer-level vehicle sales transactions.
products.reference: CDK Global DMS F&I Deal Jacket

attributes.name: retail_sale_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each retail vehicle sale transaction record in the dealer domain. Primary key for the retail_sale data product.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: Each retail vehicle sale generates an OEM AR invoice for dealer billing and revenue recognition. Linking retail_sale to ar_invoice enables deal-level invoice reconciliation, supports revenue recogniti

attributes.name: fleet_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.fleet_contract. Business justification: Fleet deals closed at a dealership are recorded as retail_sales but must reference the governing fleet_contract for volume discount validation, committed-volume tracking, and fleet program compliance

attributes.name: inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_inventory. Business justification: A retail sale sells a specific vehicle unit from dealer inventory. retail_sale.stock_number is a denormalized reference to dealer_inventory.stock_number — the stock number identifies the exact invento

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Retail sale conversion analysis links the final sale back to the originating sales opportunity for win‑loss tracking.

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that executed the retail sale transaction. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: primary_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer (buyer) who purchased the vehicle. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud CRM; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: trade_in_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.trade_in. Business justification: A retail deal with a trade-in must reference the trade_in record for lien/title processing, reconditioning cost tracking, and used-vehicle disposition reporting. retail_sale currently stores trade_in_

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.vehicle_build. Business justification: Retail sale records must trace to the vehicle_build for warranty start validation, homologation market confirmation, battery/engine serial number capture, and regulatory traceability (NHTSA/EPA). The

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: OEM retail sales reporting and incentive reconciliation require direct production-to-retail traceability. Linking retail_sale to vehicle_order enables OEM to validate that the sold unit matches the or

attributes.name: apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) on the retail installment contract as disclosed to the customer under Regulation Z. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0699 for 6.99%). Null for cash and lease deals.
attributes.references: Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z; CFPB; CDK Global DMS F&I

attributes.name: back_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned from F&I products and dealer reserve on the financing (back-end), representing the total F&I department contribution to the deal. Key dealer profitability metric.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA Dealer Financial Profile

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion). Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IATF 16949 Record Retention; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this retail sale record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-market dealer network operations.

attributes.name: deal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric deal reference number assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module at the time the deal is opened. Used for cross-referencing with dealer records, lender submissions, and OEM reporting.

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the retail sale deal. 'draft' indicates deal is being structured; 'pending' indicates awaiting lender funding approval; 'funded' indicates lender has funded the deal; 'unwound' indicates a previously funded deal that was reversed; 'cancelled' indicates deal was voided before funding.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NHTSA Dealer Reporting

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was physically delivered to the customer following Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI). May differ from sale_date when delivery is deferred. Used for warranty start date determination and OEM retail reporting.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; NHTSA; OEM Warranty Policy

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the vehicle sale, calculated as MSRP minus sale price. Includes dealer discounts, OEM incentive discounts, and employee pricing adjustments. Used for dealer margin analysis and OEM incentive reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; OEM Incentive Program Guidelines

attributes.name: dms_deal_reference
attributes.description: The native deal identifier assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module. Used for source system traceability, reconciliation, and integration with downstream OEM reporting and lender portals.

attributes.name: doc_fee
attributes.description: Dealer-charged documentation and processing fee included in the deal. Subject to state-level regulatory caps in many jurisdictions. Disclosed on the buyer's order.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; State DMV Regulations; FTC

attributes.name: down_payment
attributes.description: Cash down payment made by the customer at the time of sale, excluding trade-in allowance. Reduces the amount financed. Used for deal structure analysis and lender submission.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB

attributes.name: fi_product_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated from Finance and Insurance (F&I) aftermarket products sold as part of the deal, including extended service contracts, GAP insurance, paint protection, tire and wheel protection, and credit life/disability insurance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA F&I Guidelines

attributes.name: finance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount financed by the customer under the retail installment contract, including vehicle price, F&I products, taxes, and fees, less down payment and trade-in allowance. Null for cash deals.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z; CFPB

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: The method by which the customer is financing the vehicle purchase. 'cash' = outright purchase; 'retail_finance' = retail installment contract through a lender; 'lease' = closed-end consumer lease; 'balloon' = balloon payment retail contract.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB; Truth in Lending Act (TILA); Consumer Leasing Act

attributes.name: fleet_sale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was sold as part of a fleet or commercial account transaction rather than a retail consumer sale. Fleet sales are tracked separately for CAFE compliance, OEM fleet incentive programs, and sales mix reporting.
attributes.references: CAFE 49 CFR Part 533; EPA; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: front_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned on the vehicle sale itself (front-end), calculated as sale price minus dealer invoice cost and pack. Excludes F&I product revenue. Key dealer profitability metric reported in DMS and OEM dealer scorecards.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA Dealer Financial Profile

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution (captive finance company, bank, credit union) that approved and funded the retail installment contract or lease. Null for cash deals. Used for lender mix reporting and dealer reserve analysis.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: The contractual term of the retail installment contract expressed in months (e.g., 36, 48, 60, 72, 84). Used for lender mix analysis, payment affordability reporting, and portfolio risk assessment.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The Model Year (MY) of the vehicle sold, as defined by the OEM and NHTSA. Used for CAFE compliance reporting, incentive program eligibility, and sales mix analytics.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; CAFE Reporting; EPA

attributes.name: monthly_payment
attributes.description: The customer's contracted monthly payment amount under the retail installment contract or lease agreement. Used for affordability analysis and customer financial profiling.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) of the vehicle as stickered, inclusive of all factory-installed options and destination charges. Expressed in the local currency (USD). Used as the baseline for discount calculation, incentive reporting, and dealer margin analysis.
attributes.references: Monroney Sticker Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); CDK Global DMS F&I

attributes.name: oem_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total value of OEM-funded customer incentives applied to the deal, including cash-back rebates, conquest bonuses, loyalty bonuses, and special program pricing. Sourced from OEM incentive program data and reconciled against dealer statements.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: oem_program_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned program code identifying the specific incentive or sales program under which the vehicle was sold (e.g., employee pricing, conquest, loyalty, fleet, rental). Used for OEM incentive claim submission and program performance reporting.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer technician prior to vehicle delivery to the customer. PDI completion is required for warranty activation and OEM delivery standards compliance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Service Module; OEM PDI Standards; IATF 16949

attributes.name: sale_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the retail vehicle sale was consummated — i.e., the date the buyer signed the retail installment contract or cash purchase agreement. This is the principal business event date used for sales reporting, OEM incentive eligibility, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; SAP S/4HANA SD; NHTSA

attributes.name: sale_price
attributes.description: The agreed-upon selling price of the vehicle as negotiated between the dealer and the customer, before trade-in allowance, taxes, and fees. This is the gross capitalized cost for lease deals or the selling price for retail finance and cash deals.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sales_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and local sales tax assessed on the vehicle sale transaction. Calculated based on the taxable selling price and the applicable jurisdiction tax rate. Used for tax remittance reporting and deal cost reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; State Revenue Authority Requirements

attributes.name: trade_in_payoff_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding loan or lease payoff balance on the customer's trade-in vehicle at the time of the deal. If payoff exceeds trade-in allowance, the difference (negative equity) is typically rolled into the new deal.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was last modified in the data platform, reflecting deal amendments, status changes, or corrections sourced from CDK Global DMS. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IATF 16949 Record Retention; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vehicle_condition
attributes.description: Condition classification of the vehicle at point of sale. 'new' indicates a new, untitled vehicle; 'used' indicates a previously titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' indicates a manufacturer-certified pre-owned vehicle meeting OEM CPO program standards.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; OEM CPO Program Standards; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OEM new vehicle limited warranty period commences, typically aligned with the delivery_date or sale_date per OEM warranty policy. Used for warranty claim eligibility determination.
attributes.references: OEM Warranty Policy; Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act; CDK Global DMS

products.name: dealer_service_appointment
products.description: Reference to SSOT owner aftersales.aftersales_service_appointment. Scheduled service appointments at a dealership for vehicle maintenance, warranty repair, recall service, or customer-pay work. Tracks appointment date/time, customer, VIN, service type, advisor assigned, estimated duration, appointment status (scheduled, checked-in, in-progress, completed, no-show), and transportation option (loaner, shuttle, wait). Sourced from CDK Global DMS service scheduling module.

attributes.name: dealer_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for local dealer_service_appointment reference

attributes.name: aftersales_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: FK reference to SSOT aftersales.aftersales_service_appointment

attributes.name: primary_dealership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealership. Business justification: A dealer service appointment is physically conducted at a specific dealership. The dealer_service_appointment product is described as 'Scheduled service appointments at [a dealership]' — the owning de

products.name: dealer_repair_order

products.name: campaign_vehicle_completion
products.description: This association product represents the completion event between a service campaign and a vehicle warranty (VIN-level entitlement). It captures the operational record of which vehicles have had which campaign remedies applied, including completion status, dates, parts installed, and technician details. Each record links one service_campaign to one vehicle_warranty with attributes that exist only in the context of this completion relationship. This is the SSOT for NHTSA recall completion reporting and OEM campaign effectiveness tracking.. Existence Justification: In automotive aftersales operations, service campaigns (recalls, field actions) are issued by OEMs to remedy defects across populations of vehicles identified by VIN. One campaign affects thousands of vehicles, and one vehicle can be subject to multiple campaigns over its lifetime (safety recalls, emissions recalls, TSBs). The business actively manages campaign completion as an operational entity - tracking which vehicles have been notified, scheduled, and remedied, with completion status, dates, technician, and repair order details. NHTSA requires VIN-level recall completion reporting, making this a regulatory compliance requirement.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_repair_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core aftersales repair order KPIs tracking revenue, labor efficiency, warranty impact, and service quality across dealership service operations"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_repair_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "repair_order_status"
      expr: aftersales_repair_order_status
      comment: "Current status of the repair order (open, in-progress, completed, closed)"
    - name: "service_type"
      expr: service_type
      comment: "Type of service performed (maintenance, repair, recall, diagnostic)"
    - name: "warranty_flag"
      expr: warranty_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the repair order is covered under warranty"
    - name: "service_center_region"
      expr: service_center_region
      comment: "Geographic region of the service center performing the repair"
    - name: "service_priority"
      expr: service_priority
      comment: "Priority level of the service request (urgent, high, normal, low)"
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Payment status of the repair order (paid, pending, partial, unpaid)"
    - name: "customer_feedback_score"
      expr: customer_feedback_score
      comment: "Customer satisfaction score for the service experience"
    - name: "service_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', open_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the repair order was opened"
    - name: "service_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', open_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter when the repair order was opened"
    - name: "service_year"
      expr: YEAR(open_timestamp)
      comment: "Year when the repair order was opened"
  measures:
    - name: "total_repair_orders"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of repair orders processed"
    - name: "total_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue generated from repair orders including labor, parts, and tax"
    - name: "total_labor_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(labor_total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue from labor charges across all repair orders"
    - name: "total_parts_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(parts_total_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total revenue from parts sales across all repair orders"
    - name: "total_labor_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(labor_total_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total labor hours consumed across all repair orders"
    - name: "avg_labor_hours_per_ro"
      expr: AVG(CAST(labor_total_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average labor hours per repair order, indicating service complexity"
    - name: "avg_revenue_per_ro"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average revenue per repair order, a key profitability indicator"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discounts applied across all repair orders"
    - name: "discount_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of gross revenue given as discounts, indicating pricing pressure or promotional activity"
    - name: "warranty_repair_orders"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN warranty_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Count of repair orders covered under warranty"
    - name: "warranty_penetration_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN warranty_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of repair orders covered by warranty, indicating product quality and warranty utilization"
    - name: "avg_labor_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(labor_rate_per_hour AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average labor rate per hour charged across repair orders"
    - name: "labor_efficiency_revenue_per_hour"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(labor_total_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(labor_total_hours AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Revenue generated per labor hour, a key efficiency and profitability metric"
    - name: "parts_to_labor_ratio"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(parts_total_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(labor_total_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Ratio of parts revenue to labor revenue, indicating service mix and profitability structure"
    - name: "unique_vehicles_serviced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT connected_vehicle_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vehicles serviced, indicating customer base reach"
    - name: "unique_customers_serviced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_party_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers serviced, indicating customer retention and acquisition"
$$
metric_views.description: Core aftersales repair order KPIs tracking revenue, labor efficiency, warranty impact, and service quality across dealership service operations

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_service_appointment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Service appointment scheduling and fulfillment KPIs tracking appointment conversion, no-show rates, cycle time, and customer satisfaction"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_service_appointment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "appointment_status"
      expr: aftersales_service_appointment_status
      comment: "Current status of the service appointment (scheduled, confirmed, in-progress, completed, cancelled)"
    - name: "service_type"
      expr: service_type
      comment: "Type of service scheduled (maintenance, repair, recall, diagnostic)"
    - name: "service_category"
      expr: service_category
      comment: "Category of service (routine, emergency, warranty, recall)"
    - name: "service_priority"
      expr: service_priority
      comment: "Priority level of the service appointment"
    - name: "no_show_flag"
      expr: no_show_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the customer did not show up for the scheduled appointment"
    - name: "warranty_flag"
      expr: warranty_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the appointment is for warranty-covered service"
    - name: "first_time_customer_flag"
      expr: is_first_time_customer
      comment: "Indicates whether this is the customer's first service appointment"
    - name: "repeat_service_flag"
      expr: is_repeat_service
      comment: "Indicates whether this is a repeat service for the same issue"
    - name: "appointment_source"
      expr: source
      comment: "Source channel of the appointment (online, phone, walk-in, mobile app)"
    - name: "appointment_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', scheduled_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the appointment was scheduled"
  measures:
    - name: "total_appointments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of service appointments scheduled"
    - name: "completed_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN aftersales_service_appointment_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Number of appointments that were completed"
    - name: "appointment_completion_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN aftersales_service_appointment_status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of scheduled appointments that were completed, indicating service fulfillment effectiveness"
    - name: "no_show_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN no_show_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Number of appointments where the customer did not show up"
    - name: "no_show_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN no_show_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of appointments resulting in no-shows, indicating scheduling effectiveness and customer commitment"
    - name: "total_appointment_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_actual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual revenue generated from completed appointments"
    - name: "avg_revenue_per_appointment"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_actual_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average revenue per appointment, a key profitability metric"
    - name: "total_estimated_revenue"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated revenue at time of appointment scheduling"
    - name: "estimate_accuracy_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(total_actual_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(estimated_gross_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Ratio of actual to estimated revenue, indicating estimation accuracy and upsell effectiveness"
    - name: "first_time_customers"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_first_time_customer = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Number of appointments from first-time customers, indicating customer acquisition"
    - name: "first_time_customer_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_first_time_customer = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of appointments from first-time customers, indicating new customer acquisition rate"
    - name: "repeat_service_appointments"
      expr: SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_repeat_service = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT))
      comment: "Number of appointments for repeat service on the same issue, indicating quality concerns"
    - name: "repeat_service_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(CASE WHEN is_repeat_service = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT)) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of appointments that are repeat services, a key quality and first-time-fix indicator"
    - name: "unique_vehicles_scheduled"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT connected_vehicle_id)
      comment: "Number of unique vehicles with scheduled appointments"
    - name: "unique_customers_scheduled"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT primary_party_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers with scheduled appointments"
$$
metric_views.description: Service appointment scheduling and fulfillment KPIs tracking appointment conversion, no-show rates, cycle time, and customer satisfaction

      comment: "Case priority level (low, medium, high, critical)"

      comment: "Month when the case was opened"
    - name: "closed_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', closed_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the case was closed"
    - name: "resolved_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', resolved_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the case was resolved"
  measures:
    - name: "total_cases"

      comment: "Number of unique customers who opened cases"
    - name: "cases_per_customer"
      expr: COUNT(1) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT party_id), 0)
      comment: "Average number of cases per customer (case frequency indicator)"
    - name: "escalated_cases"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of cases that were escalated"
    - name: "escalation_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of cases that required escalation (quality and complexity indicator)"
    - name: "closed_cases"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN case_status = 'closed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of cases that have been closed"
    - name: "case_closure_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN case_status = 'closed' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of cases successfully closed (operational efficiency metric)"
    - name: "sla_breached_cases"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN resolved_timestamp > sla_due_timestamp THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of cases resolved after SLA deadline"
    - name: "sla_compliance_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN resolved_timestamp <= sla_due_timestamp THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN resolved_timestamp IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of resolved cases meeting SLA commitments (service quality KPI)"
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`customer_individual`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Individual customer profile and lifetime value metrics tracking customer segmentation, loyalty, engagement, and revenue potential."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`customer`.`individual`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "customer_type"
      expr: customer_type
      comment: "Classification of customer type (new, returning, VIP, fleet)"
    - name: "segment"
      expr: segment
      comment: "Customer segment classification for targeted marketing and service"
    - name: "loyalty_tier"
      expr: loyalty_tier
      comment: "Customer loyalty program tier (bronze, silver, gold, platinum)"
    - name: "gender"
      expr: gender
      comment: "Customer gender for demographic analysis"
    - name: "age_band"
      expr: CASE WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - YEAR(date_of_birth) < 25 THEN 'Under 25' WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - YEAR(date_of_birth) BETWEEN 25 AND 34 THEN '25-34' WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - YEAR(date_of_birth) BETWEEN 35 AND 44 THEN '35-44' WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - YEAR(date_of_birth) BETWEEN 45 AND 54 THEN '45-54' WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - YEAR(date_of_birth) BETWEEN 55 AND 64 THEN '55-64' WHEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - YEAR(date_of_birth) >= 65 THEN '65+' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Customer age band derived from date of birth"
    - name: "annual_income_band"
      expr: annual_income_band
      comment: "Customer annual income range for purchasing power analysis"
    - name: "education_level"
      expr: education_level
      comment: "Highest education level attained by customer"
    - name: "employment_status"
      expr: employment_status
      comment: "Current employment status of customer"
    - name: "marital_status"
      expr: marital_status
      comment: "Marital status of customer"
    - name: "country_of_residence"
      expr: country_of_residence
      comment: "Country where customer resides"
    - name: "state_province"
      expr: state_province
      comment: "State or province of customer residence"
    - name: "preferred_contact_method"
      expr: preferred_contact_method
      comment: "Customer's preferred method of contact"
    - name: "marketing_consent_status"
      expr: CASE WHEN marketing_opt_in_email = TRUE OR marketing_opt_in_phone = TRUE OR marketing_opt_in_sms = TRUE THEN 'Opted In' ELSE 'Opted Out' END
      comment: "Whether customer has consented to any marketing communications"
    - name: "nps_category"
      expr: CASE WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 9 THEN 'Promoter' WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 7 THEN 'Passive' WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 0 THEN 'Detractor' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Net Promoter Score category (Promoter, Passive, Detractor)"
    - name: "individual_status"
      expr: individual_status
      comment: "Current status of the individual customer record"
    - name: "onboarding_year"
      expr: YEAR(record_audit_created)
      comment: "Year when customer record was created"
  measures:
    - name: "total_customers"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of individual customers"
    - name: "active_customers"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN individual_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of active individual customers"
    - name: "total_cltv"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cltv_estimate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated customer lifetime value across all customers"
    - name: "avg_cltv"
      expr: AVG(CAST(cltv_estimate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average customer lifetime value per customer (strategic revenue indicator)"
    - name: "marketing_opt_in_customers"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN marketing_opt_in_email = TRUE OR marketing_opt_in_phone = TRUE OR marketing_opt_in_sms = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of customers who have opted in to marketing communications"
    - name: "marketing_opt_in_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN marketing_opt_in_email = TRUE OR marketing_opt_in_phone = TRUE OR marketing_opt_in_sms = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of customers opted in to marketing (engagement and consent metric)"
    - name: "promoters"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 9 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of customers classified as NPS promoters"
    - name: "detractors"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 0 AND CAST(nps_score AS INT) <= 6 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of customers classified as NPS detractors"
    - name: "net_promoter_score"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 9 THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(nps_score AS INT) >= 0 AND CAST(nps_score AS INT) <= 6 THEN 1 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN nps_score IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Net Promoter Score: percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors (customer loyalty KPI)"
    - name: "multi_vehicle_owners"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(vehicle_ownership_count AS INT) > 1 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of customers who own multiple vehicles"
    - name: "multi_vehicle_ownership_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(vehicle_ownership_count AS INT) > 1 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of customers owning multiple vehicles (loyalty and wallet share indicator)"
$$
metric_views.description: Individual customer profile and lifetime value metrics tracking customer segmentation, loyalty, engagement, and revenue potential.

    - name: "high_value_concentration_pct"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`customer_telemetry_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Connected vehicle telemetry metrics tracking vehicle health, usage patterns, battery performance, and connectivity quality for predictive maintenance and customer engagement."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`customer`.`telemetry_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "event_type_code"
      expr: event_type_code
      comment: "Type of telemetry event captured"
    - name: "event_source"
      expr: event_source
      comment: "Source system or module generating the telemetry event"
    - name: "connectivity_status"
      expr: CASE WHEN connectivity_status = TRUE THEN 'Connected' ELSE 'Disconnected' END
      comment: "Vehicle connectivity status at time of event"
    - name: "charging_status"
      expr: CASE WHEN charging_status = TRUE THEN 'Charging' ELSE 'Not Charging' END
      comment: "Battery charging status for electric vehicles"
    - name: "ignition_state"
      expr: CASE WHEN ignition_state = TRUE THEN 'On' ELSE 'Off' END
      comment: "Vehicle ignition state at time of event"
    - name: "signal_quality"
      expr: signal_quality
      comment: "Quality of telemetry signal transmission"
    - name: "location_country"
      expr: location_country
      comment: "Country where the telemetry event was captured"
    - name: "location_state"
      expr: location_state
      comment: "State where the telemetry event was captured"
    - name: "location_city"
      expr: location_city
      comment: "City where the telemetry event was captured"
    - name: "firmware_version"
      expr: firmware_version
      comment: "Firmware version of the vehicle ECU"
    - name: "event_date"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('DAY', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Date of the telemetry event"
    - name: "event_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_timestamp)
      comment: "Month of the telemetry event"
    - name: "battery_health_band"
      expr: CASE WHEN battery_soc_percent >= 80 THEN 'Healthy (80%+)' WHEN battery_soc_percent >= 50 THEN 'Moderate (50-79%)' WHEN battery_soc_percent >= 20 THEN 'Low (20-49%)' WHEN battery_soc_percent < 20 THEN 'Critical (<20%)' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Battery state of charge health band"
  measures:
    - name: "total_telemetry_events"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of telemetry events captured"
    - name: "unique_connected_vehicles"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT connected_vehicle_id)
      comment: "Number of unique connected vehicles transmitting telemetry"
    - name: "events_per_vehicle"
      expr: COUNT(1) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT connected_vehicle_id), 0)
      comment: "Average number of telemetry events per vehicle (connectivity engagement metric)"
    - name: "connected_events"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN connectivity_status = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of events captured while vehicle was connected"
    - name: "connectivity_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN connectivity_status = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of events with active connectivity (service quality indicator)"
    - name: "avg_battery_soc_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(battery_soc_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average battery state of charge percentage (EV health metric)"
    - name: "avg_battery_voltage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(battery_voltage_volt AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average battery voltage in volts (battery health indicator)"
    - name: "avg_engine_temperature"
      expr: AVG(CAST(engine_temperature_c AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average engine temperature in Celsius (thermal health metric)"
    - name: "avg_speed_kph"
      expr: AVG(CAST(speed_kph AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average vehicle speed in kilometers per hour (usage pattern indicator)"
    - name: "avg_odometer_km"
      expr: AVG(CAST(odometer_km AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average odometer reading in kilometers (vehicle age and usage metric)"
    - name: "avg_fuel_level_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(fuel_level_percent AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average fuel level percentage (refueling behavior indicator)"
    - name: "low_battery_events"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN battery_soc_percent < 20 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of events with critically low battery state of charge"
    - name: "low_battery_event_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN battery_soc_percent < 20 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN battery_soc_percent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of battery events with critical low charge (range anxiety and service need indicator)"
    - name: "charging_events"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN charging_status = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of events captured while vehicle was charging"
    - name: "avg_gps_accuracy_m"
      expr: AVG(CAST(gps_accuracy_m AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average GPS accuracy in meters (location service quality metric)"
$$
metric_views.description: Connected vehicle telemetry metrics tracking vehicle health, usage patterns, battery performance, and connectivity quality for predictive maintenance and customer engagement.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`customer_vehicle_ownership`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Vehicle ownership lifecycle metrics tracking acquisition, retention, disposition, and customer vehicle portfolio value."
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`customer`.`vehicle_ownership`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "ownership_type"
      expr: ownership_type
      comment: "Type of vehicle ownership (lease, finance, cash, fleet)"
    - name: "vehicle_ownership_status"
      expr: vehicle_ownership_status
      comment: "Current status of the vehicle ownership record"
    - name: "acquisition_channel"
      expr: acquisition_channel
      comment: "Channel through which the vehicle was acquired"
    - name: "disposition_type"
      expr: disposition_type
      comment: "Type of vehicle disposition (trade-in, sale, lease-end, total-loss)"
    - name: "is_primary_vehicle"
      expr: CASE WHEN is_primary_vehicle = TRUE THEN 'Primary' ELSE 'Secondary' END
      comment: "Whether this is the customer's primary vehicle"
    - name: "registration_country"
      expr: registration_country
      comment: "Country where the vehicle is registered"
    - name: "registration_state"
      expr: registration_state
      comment: "State where the vehicle is registered"
    - name: "acquisition_year"
      expr: YEAR(acquisition_date)
      comment: "Year when the vehicle was acquired"
    - name: "disposition_year"
      expr: YEAR(disposition_date)
      comment: "Year when the vehicle was disposed"
    - name: "ownership_tenure_band"
      expr: CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(COALESCE(disposition_date, CURRENT_DATE()), acquisition_date) < 365 THEN 'Under 1 Year' WHEN DATEDIFF(COALESCE(disposition_date, CURRENT_DATE()), acquisition_date) BETWEEN 365 AND 1094 THEN '1-3 Years' WHEN DATEDIFF(COALESCE(disposition_date, CURRENT_DATE()), acquisition_date) BETWEEN 1095 AND 1824 THEN '3-5 Years' WHEN DATEDIFF(COALESCE(disposition_date, CURRENT_DATE()), acquisition_date) >= 1825 THEN '5+ Years' ELSE 'Unknown' END
      comment: "Length of vehicle ownership tenure"
  measures:
    - name: "total_vehicle_ownerships"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of vehicle ownership records"
    - name: "active_vehicle_ownerships"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN vehicle_ownership_status = 'active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of active vehicle ownerships"
    - name: "unique_vehicle_owners"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT party_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers who own vehicles"
    - name: "vehicles_per_owner"
      expr: COUNT(1) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT party_id), 0)
      comment: "Average number of vehicles per owner (customer wallet share indicator)"
    - name: "total_purchase_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(purchase_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total purchase value of all vehicle acquisitions"
    - name: "avg_purchase_price"
      expr: AVG(CAST(purchase_price AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average purchase price per vehicle (transaction value metric)"
    - name: "total_current_odometer"
      expr: SUM(CAST(current_odometer AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total current odometer reading across all vehicles"
    - name: "avg_current_odometer"
      expr: AVG(CAST(current_odometer AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average current odometer reading per vehicle (usage intensity indicator)"
    - name: "disposed_vehicles"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN disposition_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of vehicles that have been disposed"
    - name: "disposition_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN disposition_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of vehicles that have been disposed (churn indicator)"
    - name: "trade_in_vehicles"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN trade_in_vin IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of acquisitions involving a trade-in vehicle"
    - name: "trade_in_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN trade_in_vin IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of acquisitions with trade-in (repeat purchase and loyalty indicator)"
    - name: "avg_odometer_at_acquisition"
      expr: AVG(CAST(odometer_at_acquisition AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average odometer reading at time of acquisition (used vehicle market indicator)"
    - name: "avg_disposition_odometer"
      expr: AVG(CAST(disposition_odometer AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average odometer reading at disposition (vehicle lifecycle usage metric)"
$$
metric_views.description: Vehicle ownership lifecycle metrics tracking acquisition, retention, disposition, and customer vehicle portfolio value.

      comment: "Month of invoice date for time-series analysis"
    - name: "accounting_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', accounting_date)
      comment: "Month of accounting date for financial reporting"
  measures:
    - name: "total_invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)

      expr: SUM(CAST(gross_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total gross invoice amount before discounts and taxes"
    - name: "total_net_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net invoice amount after discounts before taxes"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(discount_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total discount amount applied to invoices"
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount on invoices"
    - name: "total_payment_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(payment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total payment amount received against invoices"

    - name: "warranty_reserve_rate_pct"

      comment: "Number of unique customers with invoices"
    - name: "unique_vehicles"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT connected_vehicle_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`manufacturing_material_consumption`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Material consumption and variance metrics tracking component usage, cost performance, scrap, and inventory accuracy in production"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`manufacturing`.`material_consumption`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "consumption_status"
      expr: consumption_status
      comment: "Status of the material consumption transaction (e.g., posted, reversed, pending)"
    - name: "goods_movement_type"
      expr: goods_movement_type
      comment: "Type of goods movement (e.g., consumption, return, scrap)"
    - name: "scrap_indicator"
      expr: scrap_indicator
      comment: "Indicates if the material was scrapped"
    - name: "reversal_indicator"
      expr: reversal_indicator
      comment: "Indicates if this is a reversal transaction"
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year
      comment: "Model year of the vehicle for which material was consumed"
    - name: "powertrain_type"
      expr: powertrain_type
      comment: "Powertrain type of the vehicle"
    - name: "shift_code"
      expr: shift_code
      comment: "Production shift during which material was consumed"
    - name: "posting_date"
      expr: posting_date
      comment: "Financial posting date of the material consumption"
    - name: "assembly_station_code"
      expr: assembly_station_code
      comment: "Assembly station where material was consumed"
    - name: "scrap_reason_code"
      expr: scrap_reason_code
      comment: "Reason code for material scrap"
    - name: "unit_of_measure"
      expr: unit_of_measure
      comment: "Unit of measure for material quantity"
  measures:
    - name: "total_material_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT material_consumption_id)
      comment: "Total number of material consumption transactions"
    - name: "total_quantity_consumed"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_consumed AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity of material consumed across all transactions"
    - name: "total_planned_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned material quantity"
    - name: "total_quantity_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(quantity_variance AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity variance (actual minus planned consumption)"
    - name: "material_yield_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(quantity_consumed AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(planned_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Material yield percentage (actual/planned) - measures material usage efficiency"
    - name: "total_material_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(material_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total material cost across all consumption transactions"
    - name: "total_cost_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(cost_variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost variance (actual minus standard material cost)"
    - name: "cost_variance_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(cost_variance_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(material_cost_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Cost variance as percentage of total material cost - key procurement and efficiency metric"
    - name: "avg_material_cost_per_unit"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(material_cost_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(quantity_consumed AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average material cost per unit consumed"
    - name: "total_scrap_transactions"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scrap_indicator = TRUE THEN material_consumption_id END)
      comment: "Total number of material scrap transactions"
    - name: "scrap_transaction_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN scrap_indicator = TRUE THEN material_consumption_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT material_consumption_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of material transactions that were scrap - indicates material quality and handling issues"
    - name: "avg_variance_pct"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(variance_percentage AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average variance percentage across all material consumption transactions"
    - name: "unique_parts_consumed"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT part_master_id)
      comment: "Total number of unique parts consumed"
$$
metric_views.description: Material consumption and variance metrics tracking component usage, cost performance, scrap, and inventory accuracy in production

    - name: "automation_level"

      comment: "Percentage of lines with JIS enabled - measures lean manufacturing adoption"
    - name: "total_agv_enabled_lines"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN agv_integration_enabled = TRUE THEN production_line_id END)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`manufacturing_production_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core production order execution metrics tracking manufacturing efficiency, cost performance, labor utilization, and quality outcomes across production orders"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`manufacturing`.`production_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "order_status"
      expr: order_status
      comment: "Current status of the production order (e.g., released, in-progress, completed, cancelled)"
    - name: "order_type"
      expr: order_type
      comment: "Type of production order (e.g., standard, rework, prototype, pilot)"
    - name: "production_stage"
      expr: production_stage
      comment: "Current manufacturing stage (e.g., body shop, paint, assembly, final inspection)"
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year
      comment: "Model year of the vehicle being produced"
    - name: "order_date"
      expr: order_date
      comment: "Date the production order was created"
    - name: "planned_start_date"
      expr: planned_start_date
      comment: "Planned start date for production order execution"
    - name: "planned_finish_date"
      expr: planned_finish_date
      comment: "Planned completion date for production order"
    - name: "priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Production priority level (e.g., high, normal, low)"
    - name: "sop_indicator"
      expr: sop_indicator
      comment: "Flag indicating if this is a start-of-production order"
    - name: "hazardous_material_flag"
      expr: hazardous_material_flag
      comment: "Indicates if hazardous materials are involved in production"
  measures:
    - name: "total_production_orders"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT production_order_id)
      comment: "Total number of unique production orders"
    - name: "total_target_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(target_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned production quantity across all orders"
    - name: "total_confirmed_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(confirmed_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total confirmed production quantity delivered"
    - name: "total_scrap_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(scrap_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity scrapped during production"
    - name: "total_rework_quantity"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rework_quantity AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total quantity requiring rework"
    - name: "scrap_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(scrap_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(target_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of target quantity that was scrapped - key quality and efficiency metric"
    - name: "rework_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(rework_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(target_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of target quantity requiring rework - indicates first-pass quality"
    - name: "order_fulfillment_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(confirmed_quantity AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(target_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of target quantity successfully confirmed - measures production plan achievement"
    - name: "total_actual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual manufacturing cost incurred across production orders"
    - name: "total_standard_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(standard_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total standard (planned) manufacturing cost"
    - name: "cost_variance"
      expr: SUM((CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(standard_cost AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total cost variance (actual minus standard) - negative indicates under-budget performance"
    - name: "cost_variance_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE)) - SUM(CAST(standard_cost AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(standard_cost AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Cost variance as percentage of standard cost - key financial performance indicator"
    - name: "avg_actual_cost_per_unit"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(confirmed_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average actual manufacturing cost per confirmed unit produced"
    - name: "avg_standard_cost_per_unit"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(standard_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(target_quantity AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average standard cost per target unit"
    - name: "total_planned_labor_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned labor hours across all production orders"
    - name: "total_actual_labor_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_labor_hours AS DOUBLE))

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`manufacturing_rework_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Rework and defect resolution metrics tracking quality issues, rework cost, cycle time, and root cause patterns in manufacturing"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`manufacturing`.`rework_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "rework_order_status"
      expr: rework_order_status
      comment: "Current status of the rework order (e.g., open, in-progress, completed, cancelled)"
    - name: "rework_type"
      expr: rework_type
      comment: "Type of rework required (e.g., repair, replacement, adjustment)"
    - name: "defect_code"
      expr: defect_code
      comment: "Standardized defect code identifying the issue"
    - name: "root_cause_code"
      expr: root_cause_code
      comment: "Root cause code for the defect"
    - name: "disposition_code"
      expr: disposition_code
      comment: "Disposition decision for the defect (e.g., rework, scrap, use-as-is)"
    - name: "priority_level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level of the rework order"
    - name: "is_safety_related"
      expr: is_safety_related
      comment: "Indicates if the defect is safety-related"
    - name: "is_regulatory_hold"
      expr: is_regulatory_hold
      comment: "Indicates if the vehicle is on regulatory hold"
    - name: "line_stoppage_flag"
      expr: line_stoppage_flag
      comment: "Indicates if the defect caused a production line stoppage"
    - name: "assembly_stage_code"
      expr: assembly_stage_code
      comment: "Assembly stage where the defect was detected"
    - name: "detection_method_code"
      expr: detection_method_code
      comment: "Method by which the defect was detected (e.g., visual, automated, test)"
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year
      comment: "Model year of the vehicle requiring rework"
    - name: "re_inspection_required"
      expr: re_inspection_required
      comment: "Indicates if re-inspection is required after rework"
  measures:
    - name: "total_rework_orders"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT rework_order_id)
      comment: "Total number of rework orders issued"
    - name: "total_safety_related_rework"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_safety_related = TRUE THEN rework_order_id END)
      comment: "Total number of safety-related rework orders - critical quality metric"
    - name: "safety_rework_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_safety_related = TRUE THEN rework_order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rework_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of rework orders that are safety-related - key regulatory and brand risk metric"
    - name: "total_line_stoppages"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN line_stoppage_flag = TRUE THEN rework_order_id END)
      comment: "Total number of rework orders that caused line stoppages"
    - name: "line_stoppage_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN line_stoppage_flag = TRUE THEN rework_order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rework_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of rework orders causing line stoppages - measures production disruption impact"
    - name: "total_rework_labor_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rework_labor_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total labor cost incurred for rework activities"
    - name: "total_rework_material_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(rework_material_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total material cost incurred for rework activities"
    - name: "total_rework_cost"
      expr: SUM((CAST(rework_labor_cost AS DOUBLE)) + (CAST(rework_material_cost AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total rework cost (labor plus material) - key cost of poor quality metric"
    - name: "avg_rework_cost_per_order"
      expr: ROUND((SUM(CAST(rework_labor_cost AS DOUBLE)) + SUM(CAST(rework_material_cost AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT rework_order_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Average total rework cost per order"
    - name: "total_planned_rework_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(planned_rework_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total planned rework hours"
    - name: "total_actual_rework_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_rework_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual rework hours consumed"
    - name: "rework_labor_efficiency_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(planned_rework_hours AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(actual_rework_hours AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Rework labor efficiency (planned/actual) - measures rework execution effectiveness"
    - name: "avg_rework_cycle_time_hours"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(actual_end_timestamp) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(actual_start_timestamp)) / 3600.0 AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average rework cycle time from start to completion in hours"
    - name: "unique_defect_codes"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT defect_code)
      comment: "Total number of unique defect codes - indicates defect pattern diversity"
    - name: "unique_root_causes"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT root_cause_code)
      comment: "Total number of unique root cause codes - supports root cause analysis"
$$
metric_views.description: Rework and defect resolution metrics tracking quality issues, rework cost, cycle time, and root cause patterns in manufacturing

  measures:
    - name: "total_platforms"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT platform_id)
      comment: "Total platforms - engineering complexity and scale efficiency KPI"
    - name: "active_platforms"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN platform_status = 'Active' THEN platform_id END)
      comment: "Count of active platforms for current engineering portfolio and investment focus"
$$
metric_views.description: Vehicle platform portfolio metrics for engineering efficiency and platform strategy

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_automotive_v1`.`_metrics`.`vehicle_vin_registry`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core vehicle production and specification metrics tracking VIN-level build quality, compliance, and lifecycle status"
  source: "`vibe_automotive_v1`.`vehicle`.`vin_registry`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "model_year"
      expr: model_year_decoded
      comment: "Model year decoded from VIN for cohort analysis"
    - name: "destination_market"
      expr: destination_market
      comment: "Target market for regulatory and sales analysis"
    - name: "homologation_market"
      expr: homologation_market
      comment: "Market where vehicle is certified for compliance tracking"
    - name: "emission_standard"
      expr: emission_standard
      comment: "Emission standard compliance level for regulatory reporting"
    - name: "vehicle_lifecycle_status"
      expr: vehicle_lifecycle_status
      comment: "Current lifecycle stage for inventory and warranty management"
    - name: "recall_flag"
      expr: recall_flag
      comment: "Recall status for quality and safety tracking"
    - name: "safety_rating"
      expr: safety_rating
      comment: "Safety rating for product quality analysis"
    - name: "telematics_enabled"
      expr: telematics_enabled_flag
      comment: "Telematics capability for connected vehicle penetration"
    - name: "build_year"
      expr: YEAR(build_date)
      comment: "Year of production for manufacturing trend analysis"
    - name: "build_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', build_date)
      comment: "Month of production for production planning and throughput"
  measures:
    - name: "total_vehicles_produced"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT vin_registry_id)
      comment: "Total unique vehicles produced - primary production volume KPI"
    - name: "vehicles_with_recalls"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN recall_flag = TRUE THEN vin_registry_id END)
      comment: "Count of vehicles flagged for recall - critical quality and safety KPI"
    - name: "telematics_enabled_vehicles"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN telematics_enabled_flag = TRUE THEN vin_registry_id END)
      comment: "Count of vehicles with telematics capability - connected vehicle strategy KPI"
    - name: "avg_curb_weight_kg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(curb_weight_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average vehicle curb weight for efficiency and design benchmarking"
    - name: "avg_battery_capacity_kwh"
      expr: AVG(CAST(battery_capacity_kwh AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average battery capacity for EV portfolio analysis"
    - name: "avg_epa_combined_mpg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(epa_combined_mpg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average EPA fuel economy for regulatory compliance and marketing"
    - name: "avg_gvwr_kg"
      expr: AVG(CAST(gvwr_kg AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average gross vehicle weight rating for capability and segment analysis"
    - name: "total_battery_capacity_kwh"
      expr: SUM(CAST(battery_capacity_kwh AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total battery capacity across fleet for supply chain and investment planning"
$$
metric_views.description: Core vehicle production and specification metrics tracking VIN-level build quality, compliance, and lifecycle status
